QuestInfo.name: The Truth About Skaia
QuestInfo.1: #p1101000# found one of Aria's old keepsakes and she thought that you should have it. Head over to #m130000000# to collect it.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101000# found Aria's Diary, or at least a piece of it. Most of of it has burned away.\n\nIt wasn't easy to accept it, but you were the only person that Aria truly trusted.

0.0: Hello Mr. Phantom. I would humbly like to request your audience in #m130000000#... if you wouldn't mind.

yes.0: Recently, I was organizing the things left behind by my aunt, the former Empress Aria, and I found something that I thought you should have.
yes.1: I have heard that you and my aunt had a sort of special relationship and I would like you to have it. Even Neinheart said it was of little consequence. I hope you will come soon.

no.0: I was sure you would want to meet, but I can understand you wanting to leave the past behind you.

1.0: You came! I'm very glad to see you! You look very... well you're fitting in, I think...

yes.0: Anyway, here's the keepsake I told you about. It's her diary and its rather damaged, I'm afraid. Some of it is still legible though...
yes.1: Empress Aria was surrounded by people that loved her, but I believe you were the only one who ever really cared for her as a person, not an Empress.
yes.2: I mean, I'm not saying I read it, but...well, um... Please just take it, will you?
yes.3: Aria thought of you as something more than a friend because she trusted you. I hope you will give me that trust as well.
